resolvedStack: Electron + Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: ForgeCAD BOM Workbench
description: ForgeCAD BOM Workbench is a native Electron desktop engineering tool for managing multi-level Bills of Materials (BOM), CAD part revisions, and supplier lead-time cost rollups with Prisma persistence.

metadata.name: ForgeCAD BOM Workbench
metadata.description: Electron desktop CAD Bill-of-Materials, revision tracking, and supplier cost workbench.

files.description: Electron, Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, Zod, react-hook-form, lucide-react, react-icons.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, RevisionStatus, Priority enums and User, Assembly, PartItem, SupplierQuote models.
Shared domain interfaces for Assembly, PartItem, SupplierQuote.
Tailwind CSS directives for industrial CAD workbench.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Welcome landing screen for ForgeCAD BOM Workbench.
Desktop workspace mounting AssemblyTree, PartsCatalog, and CostRollup renderer panels.
Client renderer component showing assemblies and revision statuses fetched from /api/assemblies.
Client renderer component displaying BOM parts with search filter and add-part form.
Client renderer component summarizing supplier quotes and unit costs.
Client hook fetching /api/assemblies on mount via useEffect.
GET and POST API route for Assembly records.
GET and POST API route for PartItem records.
